name: Micron Technology

eyebrow.en: Micron Technology, Inc. · Common stock · Boise, Idaho
eyebrow.zh: 美光科技 · 普通股 · 爱达荷州博伊西

title.en: Memory is the bottleneck, and Micron collects the toll.
title.zh: 内存成了瓶颈，美光坐收过路费。

lede.en: AI servers need more DRAM, HBM and flash than the industry can make. Micron's quarterly revenue went from $11.3B to $54.2B in a year at an 87% gross margin, and management sees supply staying tight through 2028. The catch: memory has always been cyclical, and capex is climbing fast.
lede.zh: AI 服务器所需的 DRAM、HBM 和闪存超出全行业产能。美光季度营收一年内由 113 亿美元增至 542 亿美元，毛利率 87%，管理层预计供应紧张将持续到 2028 年。隐忧是：内存一向具周期性，而资本开支正快速上升。

s.zh: Q1 指引每股 $38.15 × 4 · GAAP 历史约 14 倍

s.en: Q1 FY27 · date not yet announced
s.zh: FY27 第一季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Micron rose more than five-fold over the past year as memory prices surged.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。随内存价格飙升，美光股价一年内涨逾五倍。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Micron's fiscal year ends around September 1, and FQ4 2026 had 14 weeks. The last bar is company guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。美光财年约在9月1日结束，FY26 第四季为14周。最后一根柱为公司指引中值。

p.en: Management expects memory supply and demand to be much tighter in 2027 and 2028 than in 2026, with no line of sight to balance. 26 strategic customer agreements cover about 35% of output through 2030.
p.zh: 管理层预计 2027、2028 年内存供需将比 2026 年更紧，看不到平衡时点。26 份战略客户协议覆盖至 2030 年约 35% 产量。

p.en: HBM prices for calendar 2027 were raised significantly to close the profit gap with conventional DRAM. Over 75% of FY27 shipments are already committed.
p.zh: 2027 年 HBM 价格大幅上调，以缩小与普通 DRAM 的利润差距。FY27 逾 75% 出货已锁定。

p.en: About $25B of capex in the first half of FY27, including ~$11.5B in Q1, mostly cleanrooms that produce from late 2028. Cost per bit is guided up by double digits in Q1.
p.zh: FY27 上半年资本开支约 250 亿美元（Q1 约 115 亿），主要是 2028 年底起投产的洁净室。Q1 每比特成本预计上升两位数。

p.en: Micron plans to return 100% of excess cash, mostly through buybacks, with larger returns starting Dec 9, 2026. It holds $73.5B of cash and investments.
p.zh: 美光计划将全部超额现金（主要以回购）回馈股东，自 2026年12月9日起加大回报。现金及投资 735 亿美元。

p.en: Memory has always swung from shortage to glut. The 86.25% gross margin guided for Q1 is the first guide in this cycle below the prior quarter's actual.
p.zh: 内存行业历来在短缺与过剩之间摆动。Q1 指引毛利率 86.25%，是本轮周期首次低于上季实际。

p.en: The stock is up more than five-fold in a year with a beta above 2. Daily swings are large, so position sizing matters.
p.zh: 股价一年涨逾五倍，贝塔值高于 2。日内波动大，仓位控制很重要。

p.en: Guide: $61.5B ±$1.5B revenue, ~86.25% non-GAAP gross margin, EPS $38.15 ±$1.00.
p.zh: 指引：营收 615 亿 ±15 亿美元，非GAAP毛利率约 86.25%，每股 $38.15 ±$1.00。

p.en: Micron said its increased capital return starts on this date.
p.zh: 美光表示自该日起加大资本回报。

p.en: Date not yet announced; second-quarter results usually come in late March.
p.zh: 日期未公布；第二季业绩通常在3月下旬发布。

sources: Q4 FY26 results and Q1 FY27 guidance (Sayer)
Q4 FY26 recap: FY26 cash flow and deposits
FY27 capex and capital return plans
Price, market cap and beta: Yahoo Finance and Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Micron Technology, Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Micron Technology, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from FQ1 2022 to FQ4 2026. Micron's fiscal year ends around September 1. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第一季至 FY26 第四季共 20 个季度。美光财年约在9月1日结束。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Micron's cash flow follows the memory cycle. It burned cash for six straight quarters through the 2023 glut (about −$6.7B in total), hovered near zero through 2025, then took off: FQ4 2026 alone produced $32.9B, and the last four quarters add up to $59B.
read.zh: 美光的现金流随内存周期起伏。2023 年供过于求期间连续六个季度烧钱（合计约 −67 亿美元），2025 年徘徊在零附近，随后爆发：仅 FY26 第四季就产生 329 亿美元，近四季合计 590 亿。

read.en: My base case uses Q1 FY27 guidance ($61.5B revenue at ~86% gross margin) and the capex plan (about $11.5B in Q1 and $25B in the first half), which gives roughly $35B of free cash flow a quarter and about $141B over four quarters. The biggest risk to this forecast is memory pricing: when supply catches up, margins and cash flow fall quickly, as 2023 showed.
read.zh: 我的基准情景采用 FY27 第一季指引（营收 615 亿美元、毛利率约 86%）及资本开支计划（Q1 约 115 亿、上半年 250 亿），得出每季约 350 亿美元、四季合计约 1410 亿的自由现金流。最大风险是内存价格：一旦供给追上，利润率与现金流会迅速下滑，2023 年即是前例。

p.en: About $25B of capex in the first half of FY27 ($11.5B in Q1), mostly construction for output from late calendar 2028.
p.zh: FY27 上半年资本开支约 250 亿美元（Q1 115 亿），主要用于 2028 年底起投产的建设。

p.en: Plan to return 100% of excess cash, mostly buybacks, with a step-up from Dec 9, 2026. The dividend costs about $170M a quarter.
p.zh: 计划把全部超额现金回馈股东（主要为回购），自 2026年12月9日起加码。股息每季约 1.7 亿美元。

p.en: Micron repaid $4.8B of debt in FQ3 and $0.7B in FQ4 2026.
p.zh: 美光在 FY26 第三季偿债 48 亿美元，第四季 7 亿。

p.en: Q1 FY27 is guided to $61.5B of revenue at about 86% gross margin, up 13% from a record quarter.
p.zh: FY27 第一季营收指引 615 亿美元，毛利率约 86%，较创纪录季度再增 13%。

p.en: Strategic customer agreements came with about $12.7B of customer deposits, which flow through operating cash.
p.zh: 战略客户协议带来约 127 亿美元客户押金，计入经营现金流。

p.en: More than 75% of FY27 shipments are committed, and 26 agreements cover about 35% of output through 2030.
p.zh: FY27 逾 75% 出货已锁定，26 份协议覆盖至 2030 年约 35% 产量。

bridgeNote.en: Micron plans to return 100% of excess cash, so most of this would go to buybacks rather than sit on the balance sheet.
bridgeNote.zh: 美光计划回馈全部超额现金，因此大部分将用于回购，而非留在资产负债表上。

extraNote.en: Capex here is gross purchases of property, plant and equipment. Micron's adjusted free cash flow uses net capex after government incentives (FY26: $62.3B adjusted).
extraNote.zh: 此处资本开支为物业、厂房及设备的总购置额。美光的调整后自由现金流采用扣除政府补贴后的净资本开支（FY26 调整后为 623 亿美元）。
